seo.travelGuideTitle: Golan Wiki — Golan Heights Travel Guide
seo.travelGuideText: The Golan Heights offers an unforgettable blend of ancient history, breathtaking natural beauty, and vibrant local culture. From the rugged volcanic peaks to the lush valleys, this region in northern Israel is the ultimate destination for adventurers and food lovers alike. Whether you're seeking a quiet weekend retreat or an action-packed vacation, the Golan Heights delivers an experience like no other.
seo.natureText: Explore world-class nature reserves, cascading waterfalls, and scenic hiking trails. The Banias Nature Reserve and Yehudiya Forest offer spectacular year-round flows, while Mount Hermon provides stunning snowy landscapes in winter. Nature lovers will find endless opportunities for bird watching, off-road jeep tours, and peaceful walks among cherry orchards.
seo.foodText: Taste the authentic flavors of the region through our curated guide to Golan Heights restaurants. Enjoy farm-to-table dining experiences, renowned local wineries, and traditional Druze cuisine. From high-end culinary establishments to cozy local eateries serving fresh labneh, pita, and grilled meats, the food scene here is rich and diverse.
seo.staysText: Find the perfect place to rest after a day of exploration. The Golan Heights boasts a wide variety of accommodations, including rustic log cabins (tzimmerim), luxury boutique hotels, and comfortable bed & breakfasts. Wake up to panoramic mountain views and enjoy renowned northern hospitality.
seo.viewpointsText: Take in the majestic landscapes from incredible scenic spots like Mount Bental, offering views across the borders, or the tranquil Birkat Ram crater lake. The Golan is famous for its wide-open skies and dramatic sunsets, providing countless perfect photo opportunities.
seo.villagesText: Experience the unique culture and warmth of the four main Druze villages: Majdal Shams, Mas'ade, Buq'ata, and Ein Qiniyye. Nestled in the high mountains, these vibrant communities offer bustling markets, incredible local sweets, and a fascinating glimpse into the rich heritage of the Golan.

about.metaTitle: About Golan Wiki | Golan Heights Places, Nature, Food & Stays
about.metaDescription: Learn about Golan Wiki — a local discovery platform for exploring places, restaurants, nature, stays, activities, villages, and local businesses across the Golan Heights.
about.heroSubtitle: Discover the Golan Heights through local places, nature, food, stays, and authentic experiences.
about.introParagraph: Golan Wiki is a local travel and discovery platform built to help people explore the best places across the Golan Heights. Our goal is simple: make it easier for visitors and locals to find restaurants, nature spots, viewpoints, activities, stays, and local businesses — all in one clear place.
about.card1Body: The Golan Heights has incredible views, villages, food, culture, and hidden places that are often hard to find online. Golan Wiki was created to collect those places, organize them clearly, and make them easier to discover in English, Hebrew, and Arabic.
about.card2Body: We focus on real places and useful information. Whether someone is planning a trip, looking for a place to eat, searching for a viewpoint, or exploring local businesses, Golan Wiki is built to help.
about.card3Body: Our mission includes helping small businesses become more visible. If you run a restaurant, guesthouse, or any local business in the Golan, this platform is built for you too.
about.card4Body: Whether you live in the Golan Heights or are visiting for the first time, Golan Wiki is designed to be useful, clear, and easy to browse — in any of the three languages of the region.
about.card5Body: This project is still growing. More places, features, photos, reviews, and local recommendations will be added over time. We want Golan Wiki to become one of the most useful and reliable local discovery platforms for the Golan Heights.
about.missionText: To support local tourism, help small businesses become more visible, and give the Golan Heights the modern digital platform it deserves.
